openings.claim: Proposed provenance ledger separates recorded rows from represented batch quantities. Make aggregation depend on evidenced replacement rather than row presence or recency. Preserve every duplicate/unmatched row and original quantity, unit, status, report and amendment references. Convert only U=5V; apply supplied status definitions and cutoffs. Exclude superseded rows with reasons, never delete. Matching replacement quantity under another identifier is candidate correspondence, insufficient identity proof.
openings.discriminator: Hypothesis: versus conversion followed by summing duplicate identifiers and preferring the newer report, avoid double-counting an incorporated amendment. Before the disturbed final pass, removal of a superseded-row reference and introduction of an undefined status should expose uncertainty wherever consequential, without unsupported definite quantities. No measured results.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes allocate 10 to inventory, 20 to amendment/status linkage, 20 to twelve batch outputs, 10 to coverage/requests. Every batch receives quantity or explicit cited disagreement; never infer missing quantities from neighbors. Issue at most three requests naming needed missing superseded-row reference, undefined status definition or cross-identifier replacement evidence. Use supplied clean/disturbed copies and extra twenty minutes for both variants; freeze outputs before opening sealed key. Compare resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and request counts.
openings.uncertainty: Dictionary/records may leave cross-identifier identity unresolved; bounded disagreement is acceptable. Thirty rows per report and eight amendments do not demonstrate speed. If linkage exceeds its allocation, freeze cited disagreements instead of guessing. Defeat: indistinguishable rival outputs, missed row coverage, unsupported certainty, over three requests or over sixty minutes. Both comparison variants must fit the extra twenty minutes; capacity is unmeasured.

lineage.reason: Preserves causal relation, complete comparison/disturbance tests, declared fit, uncertainties and stopping/resource caveats.

decision: Probe D1. Seven stipulated agreements establish neither amendment identity nor performance. No reconciliation has been executed; probe evidence supports bounded workflow choice, not deployment reliability.
